attack.note: Basic attacks matter through One in the Chamber (65 percent extra after an ability) or Anti-Armor Shells (250 percent damage and armor shred), but the core is Snipe and Triple Tap, which are abilities.

poke.note: Snipe deals 230 damage from long range but is a straight projectile that dies to any body in the way and resets her stacks on a miss. Pinning Shot is unmissable but weak. Triple Tap is a locked on channel but its slow shots are blocked by structures and allies.

damage.note: Her damage comes as big single target hits: Snipe stacks to 55 percent extra, Triple Tap does 3 times 372, Precision Strike 435 in an area. Healing cannot undo that, so healers do little against her except pre shielding. The measured 2627 hero damage per minute is only a bit above league median, because she spends long periods in stealth walking, which makes her an assassin with a modest damage per minute but high kill pressure (12.5 takedowns per game).

good_into.why: Snipe at long range from stealth plus Triple Tap or Precision Strike can delete a low Health Hero that has no way to block the line.
Snipe is a straight projectile and Precision Strike has a 1.5 second delay, so stationary or slow targets eat every hit and keep her Precision Sniper stacks.
Her damage arrives in single big hits and Crippling Shot adds 20 percent damage taken, so AoE healing over time does not keep targets up.
Fragile ranged heroes expose themselves in lane, and Permanent Cloak lets her find isolated ones and Snipe them. The guide notes the psychological pressure of a stealth pick on them.
Holo Decoy blocks or defuses summon style skillshots and traps, and Precision Strike clears minions from global range.

bad_into.why: She has no mobility, only Ghost Protocol, so a diver that finds her through the shimmer kills her. The guide calls her extremely weak to dive.
Assassins with gap closers reach her faster than Pinning Shot can slow them and her Health pool is low.
Mobile heroes dodge Snipe and each miss resets Precision Sniper stacks to zero.
Any stun interrupts the stationary Triple Tap channel and she has no unstoppable tool.
Her single shots get blocked by a frontline, and with no wave clear she cannot do much when a team simply stands in front.

wants_from_team: Crowd control to make Snipe and Precision Strike land
A team that can fight while she roams and picks off isolated targets
Wave clear and camp help because she has little of either
A frontline between her and enemy divers
gives_team: Global Precision Strike for follow up and structure finishing
Stealth pressure that makes the enemy play defensively
High single target burst to kill key backliners
Holo Decoy to block skillshots such as Hook or a trap
weaknesses: Very weak wave and camp clear
Burst resets on a missed Snipe
evidence: MEASURED block: 87 games only, win rate 0.678, takedowns 12.5 per game, damage taken 965 per minute (lowest of the set)
owner_notes: A burst ranged assassin focused on pick kills. Weak without much sustain, but strong when the player is good and ganks the offlaner or vulnerable heroes.
